name: As the Crow Flies
s: A young fan maneuvers her way into a seasoned anchor's newsroom but soon confronts the dark side of ambition, envy and the desire to be seen.

paragraphs.text: Kuş Uçuşu (English: As the Crow Flies), is a Turkish drama television series consisting of 24 episodes divided into three seasons, distributed on the Netflix streaming platform from June 3, 2022 to April 11, 2024. It is created by Meriç Acemi, who also wrote the screenplay, directed by Deniz Yorulmazer (in the first season), Koray Kerimoğlu (in the second season) and Burak Müjdeci (in the third season), produced by Ay Yapım and stars Birce Akalay, Miray Daner and İbrahim Çelikkol.
